The TRANSITION branch takes the trend-breakout configuration wholesale - entry, stop and the R1/R1.5/R2 ladder from the same row - so no geometry is borrowed across branches. Daily floor pivots, standard formula P = (H + L + C) / 3, from the D-1 cash session of 21 May 2026 (H 7471.80, L 7394.10, C 7450.30): P = 22316.20 / 3 = 7438.733; R1 = 2P - L = 7483.367; S1 = 2P - H = 7405.667; R2 = P + (H - L) = 7438.733 + 77.70 = 7516.433. R = 7443.20 - 7412.28 = 30.92 points = 0.41 x ATR14 (cash) / 0.37 x ATR14 (full day); inside the mandatory 0.3-3.0 x ATR14 band (22.87 to 228.72 points on the cash basis) and below 1.00 x ATR14, so no wide-stop flag. Targets are structural, not R-multiples: TP1 = R1 = 7483.37 (40.17 points from entry = 0.53 x ATR14, well inside the 2.5 x ATR14 limit of 190.60), TP2 = R1.5 = 7499.90, TP3 = R2 = 7516.43.
